blocks.text: CLEANOUT FAQ
Cleanout Services in Etobicoke — Access Questions, Straightforward Answers

items.q: How much do cleanout services cost in Etobicoke?
a: Truck volume decides: small cleanouts from $125, whole homes and suites scaling openly with what their contents fill. Stairs, elevators and long carries never add a line — the exact figure is written free at the walkthrough and holds to the invoice.

items.q: We're in a condo — how does a cleanout work with the building's rules?
a: By the book, every time. Certificates of insurance go to management at booking, the freight elevator books ahead, and hallways and lobbies get protected throughout. The crew clears the suite completely and leaves the building exactly as they found the common areas.

items.q: Does a third-floor walk-up cost more than a ground-floor cleanout?
a: No — never. The quote prices the contents, not the stairs. A walk-up carries the same flat rate as a bungalow with a driveway; the extra effort is ours to manage, not yours to pay for.

items.q: How do you handle an estate cleanout, condo or house?
a: The same careful way regardless of address type. Keepsakes, documents and valuables get set aside first, meaningful finds come to the family rather than a bin, and executors get updates and documentation without needing to be on site.

items.q: What happens when you find valuables or documents?
a: They go straight to you or the executor, every time. Cleanouts surface cash, papers and jewellery in unlikely places, and our crews are trained to slow down exactly there — the find-and-set-aside habit is non-negotiable.
